summary: Liberty Star Uranium Metals Corp. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement with 1800 Diagonal Lending LLC, issuing a convertible promissory note with $73,700 principal, 8% interest, 10% OID, maturing May 30, 2027. The note is convertible into common stock. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation. No change of control, tender, or strategic review. Filing includes material agreement and financial obligation items. Watch for future conversions and dilution, but no risk-arb angle applicable.
